liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (3 reviews): Describes the Dark Star as complex and agile, likened to a gymnast working through quadratic equations; Reviewer calls the Dark Star amazing [7][10][13]
- **Saint Stephen** (1 review): St. Stephen is delicate and energetic at once [10]
- **The Eleven** (1 review): Reviewer thinks this may be the best version of The Eleven ever played [5]
- **Cryptical Envelopment** (1 review): The Cryptical reprise arrives with tremendous force, like the crack of doom [7]
- **Alligator** (1 review): The Alligator into Caution jam seems to go on endlessly [7]

## The recordings

- **gd69-03-02.sbd.16track.kaplan.3344.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 16 songs; 164 min; rated 4.58/5 by 26 [1]. Said about its sound: Vocals are well balanced across channels: Bobby in the left ear, Jerry in the right [10]
- **gd1969-03-02.sbd.bertha-ashley.7345.shnf**: soundboard; 16 songs; 164 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1969-03-02.132581.sbd.16track.healy-latvala-wise.flac16**: soundboard; 14 songs; 165 min; rated 4.12/5 by 8 [3]

## Around the show

- Calls this the best of the four-night Fillmore run from 2/27 to 3/02, and the best show of the year [7]
- Agrees with another reviewer that this whole Fillmore run is excellent and this show tops it [11]
- Strongest opening of the four-night Fillmore stand, but lacks the closing punch of the two previous nights [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd69-03-02.sbd.16track.kaplan.3344.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Multitrack reel master to DAT to CD, extracted with EAC to SHN, via Seth Kaplan and Darrin Sacks [1]
- **gd1969-03-02.sbd.bertha-ashley.7345.shnf**: transferred by Jay Ashley; source: Bertha Remaster of the Multi-Track source. [2]
- **gd1969-03-02.132581.sbd.16track.healy-latvala-wise.flac16**: taped by Dan Healy; transferred by Dick Latvala and Jim Wise; source: Ampex MM-1000 16 Track Master Two Inch Wide Tape-Multi Track Mix-down By Dan Healy @ 44.1KHz); DAT x ONE by Dick Latvala- DAT x TWO; Editing (Adobe Audition… [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by lostlivedead.blogspot.com: [December 4-7, 1969 Fillmore West, San Francisco, CA: Grateful Dead/The Flock/Humble Pie (x-Altamont)](https://lostlivedead.blogspot.com/2023/03/december-4-7-1969-fillmore-west-san.html) [17]
